entry_authorization: none until the deterministic terminal-payoff and executable orphan-safety proof both pass
hypothesis: A Polymarket and Kalshi bundle can be a terminal payoff lock only when every outcome-defining rule dimension is independently certified equal and the worst legal terminal and incomplete-fill states remain non-negative after doubled fees, walked depth and orphan reserve.

identity_contract.rule_provenance: immutable source text and content hash from each venue

payoff_and_execution_contract.state_space: enumerate every legal joint terminal state and prove the bundle payout
payoff_and_execution_contract.price_benchmark: synchronized executable asks walked at 5, 10 and 25 shares
payoff_and_execution_contract.costs: current per-market venue fees at two times, one adverse tick per leg and capital-duration charge
payoff_and_execution_contract.orphan_reserve: worst immediate executable unwind loss for every non-empty proper subset of filled legs
payoff_and_execution_contract.fok_feasibility: required independently on each venue; no simultaneous acknowledgement is assumed
payoff_and_execution_contract.qualification: minimum terminal payout minus full executable cost minus orphan reserve is strictly positive

evaluation.null_outcome: No fully certified and orphan-safe positive bundle is a valid deterministic-scanner result. Similar wording or arithmetic parity alone is not evidence.
